speaker: Doctor
text: I'm Dr. Agent. Please tell me, did you experience any specific symptoms like chills, nausea, or changes in your urine color since your sinusitis treatment began? Also, could you clarify which antibiotics were prescribed to you?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: That combination of fever, flank pain, and fatigue suggests the infection may have spread to your kidneys. Did you notice any urinary symptoms like burning, urgency, or foul-smelling urine, and do you have any known kidney stones? Please also tell me exactly which antibiotic you took for your sinusitis.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis complicated by a possible allergic reaction to the initial antibiotic. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, and CBC with Differential.
